SELECT clubowner_key, club_name, club_logo, club_region, club_status, TO_CHAR(club_created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') club_created, club_content FROM Club WHERE clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key} AND club_status = '1'

SELECT p.clubjoin_num, p.position, p.height, p.weight, p.join_date, p.status, m.userName, m.userLevel, m.memberIdx AS memberIdx, c.club_logo, m2.profile_photo, pr.rating FROM Player p JOIN clubJoin cj ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN Club c ON c.clubOwner_key = p.clubOwner_key LEFT JOIN Member1 m ON cj.memberIdx = m.memberIdx LEFT JOIN Member2 m2 ON m.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx LEFT JOIN Player_Record pr ON p.clubJoin_num = pr.clubJoin_num WHERE p.clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key} AND c.club_status = '1' ORDER BY p.clubjoin_num ASC
SELECT userName FROM clubOwner cq JOIN Member1 m ON cq.memberIdx = m.memberIdx WHERE cq.clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key}

SELECT p.clubjoin_num, position, uniform_no, height, weight, p.clubowner_key, TO_CHAR(p.join_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS join_date, p.status, m.userName, TO_CHAR(m2.birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, tel, gender, profile_photo, NVL(pr.goal, 0) AS goal, NVL(pr.assist, 0) AS assist, NVL(pr.yellow, 0) AS yellow, NVL(pr.red, 0) AS red FROM Player p JOIN clubJoin cj ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN Club c ON c.clubOwner_key = p.clubOwner_key LEFT JOIN Member1 m ON cj.memberIdx = m.memberIdx LEFT JOIN Member2 m2 ON m.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT clubjoin_num, SUM(NVL(goal, 0)) AS goal, SUM(NVL(assist, 0)) AS assist, SUM(NVL(yellow, 0)) AS yellow, SUM(NVL(red, 0)) AS red FROM Player_Record GROUP BY clubjoin_num ) pr ON p.clubJoin_num = pr.clubjoin_num WHERE p.clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key} AND c.club_status = '1' ORDER BY p.clubjoin_num

club_status = '1'

ORDER BY p.clubjoin_num DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

club_status = '1'
